description: Why: an O(n) filesystem scan on every write scales poorly: a store with 100k blocks will stat 100k directory entries per article ingested. What: fs_store.rs dir_bytes_used iterates all entries in the store directory with read_dir to sum byte sizes. This is called on every put_raw to enforce the byte budget. Maintain a running atomic byte counter updated on put and delete, initialized from a single scan at startup.
title: FsStore::dir_bytes_used O(n) directory scan on every write
